name: olake-portable-backfill-plan-artifacts
instr:
olake cannot inspect source-specific backfill work as a portable artifact and later execute that exact work during sync. Expose the contract from `github.com/datazip-inc/olake/types`, with deterministic catalog-bound identity, versions, ordered opaque chunks, strategies, estimates, and warnings, without normalization.

Planning must validate the configured selection and atomically publish one catalog-ordered artifact. Its JSON encoding must be byte-deterministic for identical logical input while preserving driver-provided chunk order and opaque value representations exactly. It must be side-effect-free: no writers, checkpoint changes, row execution, statistics changes, partial results, or newly readable artifacts on cancellation.

Through an existing DriverInterface supplied to abstract.NewAbstractDriver(ctx, driver), every implementation among DB2, MSSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Postgres, MongoDB, S3, and Kafka must independently plan its existing source mechanics, estimates, warnings, and opaque executable chunks without mutating state or writer statistics. Preserve Kafka's classified unsupported failure. Relational plans must distinguish driver-selected key strategies from physical keyless fallbacks and report source estimates. Preserve MongoDB ObjectID, mixed-identifier, and bucket behavior with BSON-compatible boundaries. S3 planning must preserve file-key membership and byte totals by grouping small objects while keeping each large object independently executable, without readin
